about: Every piece of text this slug's build script paints onto its texture; checked by tools/validation/validate-us-english.mjs. Regenerate: node tools/validation/validate-us-english.mjs --update

model.py: This card is the property of the Republic of Everon.
If found, hand it to any police station or post office.
A replacement is issued by the registry clerk on payment of the fee.
